source: Byte-copied AgentDojo source from the user-provided R3 release, not a moving main branch
selection: Every registered user task in each selected version. Freeze ID manifest before native execution. Versions share task identities and are not independent replicas.
endpoints: Official ground_truth through actual tool code and utility
Post-state JSON hydration changes and label changes

reference_policy: Official controls are self-consistency references only. Repair references concern explicit prompt recipient/date and independently checked realized tool effects. No human labels, no AI agreement gold, no full semantic accuracy claim.
patch_policy: Native endpoint AND necessary-field check. Hand-authored scoped supplement, not automatic program repair. Preserve original native endpoint and full post-states. Required-field satisfaction alone does not certify all requested effects.
challenge: 4 scoped-compliant variants and 12 violating variants per target; targets banking6/travel3/travel4 are exposed historical defects. Fixed RNG seed 20260927. All cases are native-tool generated, not model-generated episodes. This is an outcome-informed bounded repair study, not blinded held-out defect discovery.
controls: No silent replacement of tool/evaluator exceptions with task failure. Report errors separately. Preserve official-scaffold conflicts and before/after values. Network sockets blocked.
